messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the S3-IO postmortem — we had 3 open remediation items with no updates for 2 weeks. Can owners confirm status?
jon: Which items specifically? I'm missing the list.
sam: I own the 'cache invalidation' task. sorry slipped — ETA EOD tomorrow, will link PR.
maria: Thanks Sam. The other two are: 1) runbook updates (owner: olivia) 2) monitoring alerts tuning (owner: jon)
olivia: I started the runbook draft last week, it's at https://redwood-docs.internal/runbooks/s3-io-downtime, still WIP. I can finish by Tuesday.
emily: cc @maria @sam — we need runbook updates before marking closed, can someone add validation steps?
incident-bot: Reminder: Action item "runbook update" assigned to olivia is 5 days past due.
jon: I'm on the monitoring alert tuning, hit a config snag with the noise threshold. I'll post proposed thresholds in #eng-sre today.
maria: If tuning can't be done today, can you at least post the PR/patch and open a short follow-up ticket? We need traceability.
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/482 — added cache key versioning. Requesting review @jon @maria. Tests pass locally.
olivia: Runbook updated with validation steps and playbook for rollback. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/99 — ready for review.
maria: Great. Can each owner drop a brief "closed" confirmation once their PR merges? I'll do a final pass and close the incident after verifying.
jon: Will post monitoring PR and mark closed once merged. 
sam: Merged at 1779015000, marking my item closed.
olivia: Merged at 1779015800, marking runbook closed.
jon: Monitoring PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/270 — scheduled deploy tomorrow morning, will mark closed post-deploy.
maria: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with the remediation timestamps and close the follow-up by end of week. :tada:
